INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.

5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.

Q1 What is Feasibility Survey? Discuss its all components. [5]


Q2 Briefly discuss the “Source of exposure” of toxic and hazardous materials. [5]


Q3 Describe the following terms:
(a) Loss Prevention
(b) HAZOP Study
[5]


Q4 Discuss the safety checklists for identifying process hazards in case of Safety Audits. [5]


Q5 Define the following:
(a) LD50
(b) LFL
(c) UFL
[5]


Q6 The storage tank system shown in Figure is used to store process feedstock. Overfilling of
storage tanks is a common problem in the process industries. To prevent overfilling, the
storage tank is equipped with a high-level alarm and a high-level shutdown system. The
high-level shutdown system is connected to a solenoid valve that stops the flow of input
stock. Develop a fault tree for the top event of "storage tank overflows".

Figure: Level control system with alarm
[5]
